backend/main.mo: Main actor for the media-sharing platform implementing video/photo upload, comments, likes, ratings, subscriptions, ad revenue tracking, and payment integrations (Stripe, Razorpay) with role-based access control.
backend/migration.mo: Defines a migration function that upgrades the actor state from the old schema to the new schema by adding razorpayConfig and adSenseConfig fields initialized to null.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (Razorpay setup modal, Razorpay checkout on Upgrade page, AdSense configuration) to their source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and key implementation details for build planning reference.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the light and dark color themes used throughout the application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React SPA, setting metadata, favicon links, and mounting the app into the #root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router route tree with all application routes (home, video/photo gallery, upload, player, settings, upgrade, payment pages, etc.) and exports the root App component.
frontend/src/components/AddToPlaylistMod: Empty file with no content; likely a placeholder for an add-to-playlist modal component.
frontend/src/components/AdRevenueDashboa: Dashboard component that displays the authenticated user's total ad earnings and per-video revenue breakdown using summary cards and a data table.
frontend/src/components/AdSenseScript.ts: Dynamically injects the Google AdSense script into the document head based on a fetched publisher ID, and removes it on cleanup.
frontend/src/components/AdSenseUnit.tsx: Renders a single Google AdSense ad unit (`<ins>` element) and pushes it to the adsbygoogle queue once the publisher ID is available.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Thin wrapper that renders the ProfileDropdownMenu component aligned to the end, intended for use in the site header.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar for mobile with links to Home, Upload, Shorts, and Subscriptions, plus a Profile tab that opens the ProfileDropdownMenu.
frontend/src/components/ChannelNameDispl: Displays a channel's name as a clickable link, fetching it by principal and falling back to a truncated principal string while loading.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Renders a comment section for a video with a submission form for authenticated users and a list of existing comments with author names and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/CreatePlaylistMo: Empty file with no content; likely a placeholder for a create-playlist modal component.
frontend/src/components/DeleteVideoButto: Renders a delete button that triggers a confirmation AlertDialog before calling the delete video mutation.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout including a sticky header with search, upload, and auth controls, a collapsible sidebar, bottom navigation, AdSense integration, and a footer.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCard.tsx: Displays a photo thumbnail card with title, uploader channel name, and upload time, linking to the photo detail page.
frontend/src/components/ProfileDropdownM: Dropdown menu for authentication and profile management, supporting multi-account switching, sign-in, sign-out, and navigation to profile/settings pages.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that appears for authenticated users without a profile, prompting them to enter a name and optional channel name, then saves the profile via mutation.
frontend/src/components/RazorpaySetupMod: A modal dialog for entering and saving Razorpay API credentials (Key ID and Key Secret) to enable INR payments.
frontend/src/components/ShareButton.tsx: A button component that copies the current page URL to the clipboard and shows a toast notification on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: A responsive sidebar navigation component with Home, Trending, and Library links, supporting mobile overlay and close behavior.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetupModal: A modal dialog for configuring Stripe payments by entering a secret key and allowed countries, saving the configuration via mutation.
frontend/src/components/TagInput.tsx: An input component that allows users to add and remove tags by pressing Enter or comma, displaying them as removable badges.
frontend/src/components/ThumbnailSelecto: A component for managing video thumbnails, supporting custom image upload, frame capture from the video, upload progress display, and thumbnail removal.
frontend/src/components/UpgradePrompt.ts: A card component that displays a premium upgrade prompt with benefits and a navigation button, shown only to authenticated non-premium users.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Renders a video card component in either 'default' (grid) or 'compact' (list) variant, displaying thumbnail, title, channel name, view count, and upload time with a link to the video page.
frontend/src/components/VideoEditModal.t: A modal dialog for editing video metadata (title, description, tags) and thumbnail, using tabs to separate details from settings, with save/cancel actions.
frontend/src/components/VideoQualitySele: A dropdown UI component for selecting video playback quality (auto, 360p–1080p), currently only managing local state without affecting actual playback.
frontend/src/components/VideoRating.tsx: Interactive 5-star rating widget that fetches the current user's rating and submits new ratings via hooks, requiring authentication to rate.
frontend/src/components/VideoRatingDispl: Read-only display of a video's average star rating and total rating count, rendering full, half, and empty stars based on the computed average.
frontend/src/components/VideoSettings.ts: Thin wrapper component that renders the ThumbnailSelector for a given video within a settings panel.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using TanStack Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddComment.ts: Mutation hook that submits a new comment for a video via the actor and invalidates related query caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdSenseConfig.ts: Provides hooks for fetching and updating the AdSense publisher ID via the backend actor, with toast notifications on success or error.
frontend/src/hooks/useAverageRating.ts: Query hook that fetches the average star rating for a given video from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useChannelName.ts: Query hook that retrieves a channel's display name from the backend actor given a principal identifier.
frontend/src/hooks/useComments.ts: Query hook that fetches the list of comments for a given video from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Mutation hook that creates a Stripe checkout session via the backend actor, returning the session ID and redirect URL.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteVideo.ts: Mutation hook that deletes a video via the backend actor, invalidates video caches, and shows appropriate success or error toasts.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAdRevenueForCal: Query hook that fetches the total ad revenue earned by the currently authenticated caller from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAdRevenueForVid: Query hook that fetches ad revenue data (impressions and total revenue) for a specific video from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook that fetches the current authenticated user's profile from the backend actor, with loading state tied to actor availability.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserRating.ts: React Query hook that retrieves the current user's rating for a specific video by fetching all user ratings and filtering by videoId.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetUserSubscriptio: React Query hook that fetches the user's subscription status from the backend and returns a normalized object indicating tier and upload permissions.
frontend/src/hooks/useIncrementVideoView: Mutation hook that calls the backend to increment a video's view count and invalidates related video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider context and useInternetIdentity hook for managing Internet Computer authentication via AuthClient, including login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useMarkThumbnailGener: Mutation hook that marks a video thumbnail as generated on the backend and invalidates video queries, showing toast notifications on success or failure.
frontend/src/hooks/useMultiAccount.ts: Hook that manages multiple Internet Identity accounts stored in localStorage, supporting adding, removing, switching, and updating account display names.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhoto.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single photo by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotos.ts: React Query hook that fetches the list of all photo metadata from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotoUpload.ts: Mutation hook that uploads a photo file to the backend actor with progress tracking and toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useRateVideo.ts: Mutation hook that submits a star rating for a video and invalidates rating-related queries with toast feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpayCheckout.t: Mutation hook that dynamically loads the Razorpay SDK, creates a payment order via the backend, opens the Razorpay checkout modal, and verifies the payment on completion.
frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpayConfig.ts: Provides hooks for checking if Razorpay is configured and for saving Razorpay API credentials to the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useRecordAdImpression: Mutation hook that records an ad impression for a video on the backend and invalidates ad revenue queries, silently ignoring errors.
frontend/src/hooks/useRemoveThumbnail.ts: Mutation hook that removes a video's thumbnail via the backend actor and invalidates video queries, with specific handling for unauthorized errors.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: Mutation hook that saves the current user's profile to the backend and invalidates profile and channel name queries with toast feedback.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchVideos.ts: React Query hook that searches videos by a search term using the actor's `searchVideos` and `getVideo` methods, returning an array of `ExtendedVideo` objects.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetChannelName.ts: Mutation hook that calls the actor's `setChannelName` method with validation (2–50 chars), then invalidates channel-related queries and shows a toast notification.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetCustomThumbnail: Mutation hook that uploads a custom thumbnail image for a video via `ExternalBlob`, tracking upload progress and invalidating video queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetSubscriptionSta: Mutation hook that calls the actor's `setSubscriptionStatus` for a given user principal and invalidates the subscription status query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useStripeConfig.ts: Provides two hooks: `useIsStripeConfigured` queries whether Stripe is configured, and `useSetStripeConfiguration` mutates the Stripe configuration via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscribe.ts: Mutation hook for subscribing to a channel; currently throws a placeholder error indicating the backend subscription feature is not yet implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubscriptionStatus: Query hook that returns a user's subscription status for a given channel principal; currently returns `false` as a placeholder until backend support is added.
frontend/src/hooks/useTotalRatings.ts: Query hook that fetches the total ratings count for a video by calling the actor's `getTotalRatings` method.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateVideo.ts: Mutation hook that updates a video's title, description, and tags via the actor, then invalidates related video queries and shows success/error toasts.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpgradeAccount.ts: Mutation hook for upgrading a user account to premium; currently throws a not-implemented error as a placeholder for future backend integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserStats.ts: Query hook that fetches user statistics (video/photo counts, account creation time) for a given principal via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideo.ts: Query hook that fetches a single video's full data by ID using the actor's `getVideo` method, returning an `ExtendedVideo` or null.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoLike.ts: Mutation hook that calls the actor's `likeVideo` method for a video ID and invalidates related video queries, showing an error toast on failure.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideos.ts: Query hook that fetches the full list of video metadata by calling the actor's `listVideos` method.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoUpload.ts: Mutation hook that uploads a video file via `ExternalBlob` with progress tracking, returning the new video ID and invalidating the videos list query on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the app.
frontend/src/lib/types.ts: Defines shared TypeScript interfaces for frontend use, including `VideoMetadata`, `ExtendedVideo`, `Photo`, `Comment`, `UserStats`, and `SubscriptionStatus`.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/pages/ChannelProfile.tsx: Page component that displays a channel's profile header (name, stats, banner) and lists the channel owner's uploaded videos, with edit/delete controls for the owner.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page that fetches and displays all videos sorted by upload time (newest first) in a responsive grid, with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Payment cancellation/failure page that informs the user no charges were made and provides buttons to retry or return home.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Payment success page that verifies a Stripe session ID, invalidates subscription query cache on success, and displays loading, success, or error states accordingly.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoGallery.tsx: Photo gallery page with debounced search filtering, loading/error states, and a responsive grid of PhotoCard components.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoViewer.tsx: Single photo viewer page that fetches a photo by ID, converts its binary data to a blob URL for display, and shows metadata including uploader and upload date.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: User profile page showing the authenticated user's uploaded videos and photos in tabs, with edit/delete actions and an ad revenue dashboard; redirects unauthenticated users to sign in.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page allowing authenticated users to update their profile, manage subscription status, configure Stripe/Razorpay payment gateways, and set an AdSense publisher ID.
frontend/src/pages/Shorts.tsx: Placeholder page for a Shorts feature that displays a 'Coming Soon' message.
frontend/src/pages/Subscriptions.tsx: Displays a placeholder Subscriptions page that shows a 'Coming Soon' message for authenticated users or a prompt to browse channels for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/Upgrade.tsx: Renders a premium upgrade page with free vs. premium feature comparison, supporting both Stripe and Razorpay checkout flows with setup modals if payment providers are not yet configured.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPhoto.tsx: Provides a photo upload form with title, description, and file selection fields, showing upload progress and a success state, and guarding against unauthenticated access.
frontend/src/pages/UploadVideo.tsx: Provides a video upload form with title, description, tags, and file validation, and after a successful upload allows the user to select a thumbnail via ThumbnailSelector.
frontend/src/pages/VideoGallery.tsx: Displays a searchable grid of video cards, debouncing the search input and switching between all videos and search results accordingly.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPlayer.tsx: Full video player page that tracks watch time to increment view counts and record ad impressions, and displays video metadata, likes, comments, related videos, and owner edit/delete controls.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Exports two utility functions: formatViewCount for converting a BigInt view count into a human-readable string (K/M/B), and formatTimeAgo for converting a nanosecond BigInt timestamp into a relative time string.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens (including sidebar and chart colors), custom border radius, Inter font family, and accordion keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file describing a content platform with Razorpay INR payment integration, Google AdSense integration, and existing feature implementations including setup modals, upgrade page payment flow, and AdSense configuration.
